properties.name: roux.problems.enabled
properties.description: Whether roux answers errors as Problem Details at all.

properties.name: roux.problems.api-path-prefix
properties.description: Where the API's paths begin: a path under it that matches nothing is a problem, and any other is a page the error page renders.

properties.name: roux.spa.excluded-paths
properties.description: Path patterns, besides /api/**, /who/**, /assets/**, /actuator/**, /.well-known/** and /error, that are never answered with the shell.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.script-src
properties.description: Hosts scripts may load from, added after 'self' and the response's nonce. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.style-src
properties.description: Hosts styles may load from, added after 'self' and the response's nonce. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.img-src
properties.description: Where images may load from, added after 'self' and data:. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.font-src
properties.description: Where fonts may load from, added after 'self'. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.connect-src
properties.description: Where the app may call (fetch, WebSocket), added after 'self'. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.frame-src
properties.description: What the app may embed, added after 'self'. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.media-src
properties.description: Where audio and video may load from, added after 'self'. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.spa.csp.form-action
properties.description: Where a form may submit to, added after 'self'. A wildcard or an unsafe keyword stops the app from starting.

properties.name: roux.theme.app-name
properties.description: What the app is called (the page title and the header); defaults to spring.application.name.

properties.name: roux.theme.palette
properties.description: A Chakra palette (gray, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, cyan, purple, pink), or brand to generate one from brand-color.

properties.name: roux.theme.brand-color
properties.description: The brand colour: # and six hex digits.

properties.name: roux.theme.shape
properties.description: How round corners are: square, slight, medium, round or extra-round.

properties.name: roux.theme.heading-font
properties.description: The lettering of headings: standard, modern, friendly or classic.

properties.name: roux.theme.body-font
properties.description: The lettering of text: standard, modern, friendly or classic.
